subject: Clarification: Targeted SOC 2 artifacts — privileged account rotation & session log slices (bridge window)
messages:
From: Jane Donovan <jane.donovan@clarityaudit.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Horton <tim.horton@medsys.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II — additional targeted artifacts needed

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks again for sending the SOC 2 Type II report and the bridge-letter overview. The audit team reviewed the report and we have a short list of targeted artifacts and clarifications we need to complete the control verification for MedSys Health (control families: CC6 - Logical & Physical Access; CC7 - System Operations). Specifically:

- Evidence of privileged account rotation for service accounts used by the inference runtime (rotation records, change requests, and verification logs) covering the audit period 2026-09-01 to 2027-02-21.
- Session-auth logs / privileged-session recordings or session IDs for console access used by platform engineers for the same period (we only need a sampling strategy — please provide slices with start/end timestamps and selection criteria).
- MFA assertion logs that show successful MFA events for privileged accounts (targeted sample from the last 6 months, with at least 20 events across different accounts).
- A short bridge letter confirming whether any changes to access controls occurred in the last 7 days of the audit period (2027-02-15 to 2027-02-21) and, if so, compensating controls.

Can you confirm feasibility and expected delivery timeline? If helpful, we can accept CSV extracts and redacted identifiers (hashed usernames) as long as the mapping key is available under NDA for us to verify.

Best,
Jane Donovan
Senior Auditor, Clarity Audit Group
jane.donovan@clarityaudit.com

--
Attachment: audit-ask-template.xlsx (spreadsheet of requested fields)
From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Donovan <jane.donovan@clarityaudit.com>, Tim Horton <tim.horton@medsys.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II — additional targeted artifacts needed

Jane — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested slices but need to coordinate scope and delivery with infra/security. Ben — can you take the lead on extracting:

1) Privileged account rotation evidence (change requests, rotation schedule entries, and keystore rotation logs) for 2026-09-01 through 2027-02-21.
2) Session-auth logs / session identifiers for console access — provide a sampling plan (how you'll pick sessions) and a CSV slice with timestamps, hashed principal id, session id, and activity summary.
3) MFA successful-event slice (20+ events across service & human privileged accounts).

Marissa — I'll need a short bridge letter draft confirming the tail-period state (2027-02-15 -> 2027-02-21). Jane asked for any changes to access controls in that window and compensating controls. I'll circulate a draft for sign-off.

Target timeline: can we get a first pass of the CSV extracts and inventory by Tue EOD (2027-02-23)? Ben, please confirm if that is doable or if you need more time.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

--
(Internal note: Keep user identifiers hashed; provide mapping under NDA if required.)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jane Donovan <jane.donovan@clarityaudit.com>, Tim Horton <tim.horton@medsys.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 14:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II — additional targeted artifacts needed

Olga — I can take this. Quick status:

- Privileged rotation: our key management service (KMS) audit logs contain rotation events; I'll pull rotation events and related change request IDs. Expect a CSV with columns: rotation_timestamp, artifact_id (hashed), rotation_type, change_request_id, approver (hashed).
- Session slices: proposing stratified sampling by week (one 24-hour window per month across the audit period) + two additional windows covering the final week (2027-02-15 to 2027-02-21). This should meet auditor sampling needs while minimizing noise.
- MFA events: will export successful MFA events for principals with privileged flags; will include timestamp, principal_hash, factor_type.

I attached an artifact inventory CSV showing planned extracts and filenames (artifact-inventory.csv).

Constraints/asks:
- Redaction: we will hash usernames and provide a secure mapping under NDA if Clarity needs to confirm identities.
- Size: session recordings are large — we will provide session IDs and activity summaries rather than full screen captures. If the auditor requires recordings we need to confirm retention policy and seek approval.

I expect to upload the CSVs to the secure drive link by Tue 02/23 EOD PST. If Jane needs anything sooner, let me know.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: artifact-inventory.csv
From: Jane Donovan <jane.donovan@clarityaudit.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Horton <tim.horton@medsys.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 08:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II — additional targeted artifacts needed

Thanks Ben/Olga — that sampling plan sounds reasonable. A couple of clarifications from the audit team:

1) For the bridge-letter request, we specifically need a concise statement on whether any privileged access policy, keystore procedure, or rotation cadence changed during 2027-02-15 through 2027-02-21. If changes occurred, please list the change, effective time, and compensating control(s) or rollback plan.

2) For session artifacts — if you cannot provide screen recordings due to retention, the CSV with session IDs and activity summaries is fine. Please ensure each row has at least one activity indicator (e.g., CLI command, config change, artifact pushed) to show session relevance.

3) For MFA events — auditors prefer at least 5 distinct principals in the sample. If you can provide 20 events across 5+ principals that will be ideal.

If you can deliver the CSVs and the draft bridge letter by Tue EOD PST we can complete our checks before presenting to MedSys on Wed. Thanks.

Best,
Jane
From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Donovan <jane.donovan@clarityaudit.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tim Horton <tim.horton@medsys.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Feb 2027 16:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II — additional targeted artifacts needed

Jane — thanks for the confirmation.

Delivery summary (per your asks):
- artifact-inventory.csv (attached) — lists planned extracts and filenames.
- mfa-log-slice-2027-02-01-2027-02-21.csv (uploaded) — 22 successful MFA events across 7 hashed principals, includes timestamp, principal_hash, factor_type.
- session-sample-CSV (uploaded to secure drive) — stratified windows as proposed; includes session_id, start_ts, end_ts, principal_hash, top_activity_tags. Full screen recordings are not retained beyond 30 days per our retention policy, so only metadata is provided; the retention policy doc is linked in the drive.
- privileged-rotation-logs.csv (uploaded) — rotation_timestamp, artifact_hash, change_request_id, approver_hash. Includes entries and links to change ticket in JIRA-SEC-4821.
- bridge-letter-draft.pdf (attached) — short statement: no changes to keystore rotation cadence or privileged access policy occurred during 2027-02-15 -> 2027-02-21. We included a paragraph about compensating monitoring (increased log sampling) for a planned maintenance window on 2027-02-18; details + approval records are referenced.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and let us know if Clarity needs the mapping key under NDA for one-off identity confirmation. We are prepared to provide the mapping under the existing DPA and confidentiality terms.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments: bridge-letter-draft.pdf, mfa-log-slice-2027-02-01-2027-02-21.csv
